decision.observation: The deposit beneath the starting room is Sandstone, not Metal Ore. The Outhouse remains under construction, and two nearby Algae deposits have been confirmed.
decision.hypothesis: A copper-colored speckled deposit in the terrain above and right of the base may be Metal Ore; inspecting it will identify a possible Oxygen Diffuser construction source.
decision.memory: Oxygen Diffuser requires 200 kg Metal Ore, 120 W power, and Algae. No Metal Ore is stored. Keep the left reservoir sealed; the farther right-side dig orders are unreachable.
